title: Your Diwali Week OTT Guide: Eleven Releases, November 2-8
excerpt: Haiwaan on SonyLIV, Black Doves Season 2 and Bass Machina on Netflix, and The Greatest on Prime Video headline a crowded Nov. 2-8 streaming week in India — with dates, platforms and languages as the weekly lists state them.
body:
• Eleven titles anchor the Nov. 2-8 list across Netflix, SonyLIV, Prime Video and Apple TV — the busiest day is Friday, Nov. 6, with five releases.
  • Top Diwali-week pick for families at home: Haiwaan, the Hindi thriller with Saif Ali Khan and Akshay Kumar, on SonyLIV on Nov. 6.
  • Plan by date: Bass Machina opens on Netflix on Nov. 3; Black Doves Season 2 lands on Netflix on Nov. 5.
  • Languages are stated where sources give them — Hindi for Haiwaan, Tamil for Meesaya Murukku 2, Polish for Anaesthesia and Japanese for One Year to Live, Buy a Man.

Streaming in India fills up in Diwali week. The Nov. 2-8 window brings 11 new movies and shows across Netflix, SonyLIV, Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV. The guide below follows that 11-title list, with details cross-checked against Esquire India and Vogue India, and languages taken from 123Telugu where it lists them.

Nov. 3-4: Animation, medicine and Muhammad Ali

Bass Machina — Nov. 3, Netflix. An adult animated steampunk Western in six episodes. Brian Tyree Henry, Tati Gabrielle and Janelle Monae lead the voice cast as an ageing gunslinger serves as judge, jury and executioner on a lawless frontier overrun by supernatural threats and rogue technology while trying to protect his family.

https://x.com/Binged_/status/2117508934089241048

Anaesthesia — Nov. 4, Netflix. A Polish medical drama starring Leszek Lichota as Dr. Dawid Lazarz, a talented surgeon who leaves a prestigious clinic for a local hospital after a complicated surgery goes wrong and tries to rebuild his career.

The Greatest — Nov. 4, Prime Video. Listed by 123Telugu as an English series, this biographical series explores the life of boxing legend Muhammad Ali, beyond his wins to his political activism, religious conversion and exile from professional boxing.

Stick Season 2 — Nov. 4, Apple TV. Owen Wilson returns as Pryce Cahill alongside Peter Dager as Santiago Wheeler. This season follows Santiago under the pressures of professional golf while Pryce pursues a comeback goal of becoming the oldest golfer to win a major championship.

Nov. 5: Spies return and a Japanese romance

Black Doves Season 2 — Nov. 5, Netflix. Keira Knightley reprises her role as Helen, a spy balancing covert work with her public identity as the wife of the Prime Minister, while Ben Whishaw as Sam faces a deadly ultimatum.

One Year to Live, Buy a Man — Nov. 5, Netflix. A Japanese romantic drama. Ko Shibasaki plays Yui, a cautious 40-year-old who learns she has one year left to live and decides to spend freely, including purchasing the services of nightclub host Sena, played by Eiji Akaso. Vogue India describes it as making its global digital premiere.

Nov. 6: The Diwali Friday rush

Haiwaan — Nov. 6, SonyLIV. The week's biggest Indian release. Listed by 123Telugu as a Hindi film, Priyadarshan's thriller stars Saif Ali Khan as Shyam Rane, a blind caretaker and building supervisor who becomes the prime suspect after his mentor, a former judge, is murdered, and Akshay Kumar as the real killer, Parshuram Gokhale. It is an official remake of the 2016 Malayalam film Oppam.

Meesaya Murukku 2 — Nov. 6, SonyLIV. A Tamil film, per 123Telugu. Hiphop Tamizha Adhi reprises his role in this sequel to the 2017 Tamil musical comedy, as aspiring musician Jeeva faces pressure when the son of a powerful film producer develops an interest in his partner, Laila.

Under Siege — Nov. 6, Netflix. A Colombian limited series revisiting the 1985 siege of Colombia's Palace of Justice, when the M-19 guerrilla unit took over 300 people hostage, including Supreme Court justices. Vogue India lists it as an eight-part series.

Campus Drivers — Nov. 6, Prime Video. A French romantic drama based on C.S. Quill's bestselling novel Crash Test. Carmen Kassovitz plays Lois, whose settled plans at Belrose University shift after she arrives heartbroken at the door of Lane, played by Baptiste Masseline, creator of the university's most popular application.

Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook — Nov. 6, Apple TV. An eight-episode food and travel series in which Nora Lum, known as Awkwafina, journeys across the country to revive her family's Cantonese restaurant, Lum's, in Flushing, New York, with help from chefs, restaurateurs and family.

Also dated this week in other lists

Wider lists from Esquire India and Vogue India add four more titles: I'm Game, a Malayalam film per 123Telugu, starring Dulquer Salmaan, on JioHotstar on Nov. 6; Dilwali Diwali, a Hindi film per 123Telugu, directed by Ritesh Menon and starring Mihir Ahuja, on Netflix on Nov. 5; Possible Love, Lee Chang-dong's first feature in eight years, on Netflix on Nov. 6; and Nooru Kodi Vaanavil, a Tamil romantic drama directed by Sasi, on ZEE5 on Nov. 6.
